svg.aria-label: Table of contents lines: dimensional anatomy
svg.text: DETAIL A · FULL ANCHOR IS THE HIT AREA
SCALE 3:1 · LABEL ALIGNS TO FIRST TRACK, NOT ROW CENTER
ANCHORS SPAN THE ROW; RULES ARE ARIA-HIDDEN.
LABELS REMAIN IN FLOW AND ACCESSIBLE.
MINIMUM ITEM LEVEL DEFINES ZERO DEPTH.
SECONDARY RULES ADOPT THE NEXT ITEM INDENT.
HOVER MODE REVEALS THE WHOLE NAV LABEL SET.
KEYBOARD FOCUS OR COARSE POINTER ALSO REVEALS.
CONSTRAINED LIST CENTERS THE ACTIVE ROW.
ONLY EDGES WITH MORE CONTENT RECEIVE A MASK.
CLICKED TARGET STAYS ACTIVE THROUGH SETTLING.
NEXT LIVE SCROLL RESTORES HEADING TRACKING.
NO CONTAINER BORDER, SHADOW, SCRIM OR POPUP.
DASHED FRAMES ARE ANNOTATIONS, NOT PAINT.
NO NESTED CORNERS; RULE END R1 = B / 2.
ALL LAYERS STAY IN NORMAL DOCUMENT FLOW.
NO PORTAL, ELEVATION OR FLOATING TOOLTIP.
SCALE 2:1 · NEXT HEADING SETS MINOR INDENT
REVEALS ALL LABELS; NO LAYOUT SHIFT.
P = 0 WHEN LIST FITS. TOP PAD = P + S3.
JS SCROLLING: INSTANT UNDER REDUCED MOTION.
SOURCE: TABLE-OF-CONTENTS-LINES + SHARED SCROLL / TRACKING + THEME · BROWSER CHECKED 2026-11-14
